fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { holidayBakeries: "My bakery takes Thanksgiving pie pre-orders for pickup on Wed, Nov 25. Build a pre-order form with hourly pickup slots that each hold 40 pies. When an hour fills, stop offering it. Show the price of each pie, total the order, and send a confirmation with the pie count, the total, and the pickup hour.", smallBatchMakers: "I forge one run of 300 chef's knives at $145 each, shipping the week of Jan 11. Build a pre-order form that shows the ship week, confirms orders 1 through 300 as they come in, and puts every order after 300 on a numbered waitlist for the next run. Tell each buyer their spot.", signedBooks: "My novel releases on Tue, Mar 2, and I sign every pre-ordered copy. Build a pre-order form with an optional inscription box that closes on Feb 16, 14 days before release. After that date, hide the box and save each order as a signed copy with no inscription.", plantNurseries: "My nursery grows spring starts to order. Build a pre-order form that closes on Mar 15, lists each variety at $4.50 a start, and totals the order. Pickup is Sat, Apr 24. Email every buyer their list with the total two days before pickup, on Thu, Apr 22." };

window.awbMockup = { floorStaff: "I run a food packing plant where line staff have no company email. Build an employee feedback form they open from a QR code by the time clock. Ask them to pick a topic first: equipment, schedules, pay, or something else. Send equipment notes to our maintenance lead and schedule notes to the shift manager, and mark each comment Received, Assigned, or Done.", oneOnOnePrep: "I manage a team of software engineers. Build a short form each engineer fills in on Wednesday before our Thursday one-on-one, with 3 questions: what went well, what is stuck, and what they need from me. Show me the answers before we meet, and bring any item marked Stuck back on the next week's form until I mark it Resolved.", draftPolicies: "I work in HR at a group of health clinics. Build a form where staff comment on a draft policy for 14 days, choosing the section each comment is about. Show me the comments grouped by section with a count for each, so I can see which section drew the most before the policy takes effect.", newToolRollouts: "I run dispatch for a freight company that just switched routing apps. Build a feedback form dispatchers fill in after 2 weeks: a rating from 1 to 5 and a box for what slows them down. Send any comment with a score of 2 or lower to our IT lead by email, and list every rating in a table I can sort." };
